description: This file contains the implementation of the Inception-ResNet V2 model for Keras, including model architecture, preprocessing, and weight loading functions.

classes.name: InceptionResNetV2
classes.description: Main class implementing the Inception-ResNet V2 architecture with optional top layers and pre-trained weights.

methods.name: preprocess_input
methods.description: Preprocesses a numpy array encoding a batch of images for the model.

methods.name: conv2d_bn
methods.description: Utility function to apply Conv2D followed by BatchNormalization and activation.

methods.name: inception_resnet_block
methods.description: Adds an Inception-ResNet block of type 'block35', 'block17', or 'block8' with residual scaling.

methods.name: InceptionResNetV2
methods.description: Constructs the Inception-ResNet V2 model, loads weights if specified, and returns the Keras model instance.
